notes.title: Pepeto
notes.notes:
Hello, hoomans! ːcathspawː

We are so grateful for the amazing reception of [b]A Shelter Full of Cats[/b]!
Thank you so much for your love and support! ːlovecatː
We have been showered with high praise, and the whole team is purring loudly while reading your wonderful opinions. 

One of the most asked questions we've been receiving is about [b]Pepeto[/b]! 
It warms our hearts to see that our fanbase is filled with such kind-hearted souls. So, today, we’re sharing his story and a quick update on him. 

The video below was recorded in February/2024, during Pepeto’s recovery from FIP. 
Please note that content in the video might disturb some viewers, so view it at your own discretion. 

https://www.instagram.com/reel/C3qL4IVpBjo/


As we always say: Time, Love, and diligent caretakers can mend almost anything! ːfofinoː

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ef9GV3o.png[/img]

Pepeto's still on foster care with a local rescuer, and we receive updates on him every other day.
He is cured from FIP now, but, recently, he developed chronic gingivostomatitis... He is being cared for and treated, but his chances of being adopted drop a little every day... Unfortunately, reality is tough for black, adult cats, especially those with a health condition...
But we'd like to reinforce that we're doing our very best to find Pepeto a forever home.
He deserves a hapy ending. ❤

Below, a video recently recorded of Pepeto (December/2024):

[previewyoutube=kkBS8N4xw40;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for being part of this journey and for your continuous support of cats in need. 
Let’s keep spreading love and kindness together! ːfofino2ː

Love and Purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

PS: We've created a new bundle for the end of the year! The purrfect christmas gift for a dearly friend: The Full of Cats Collection!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48895/Full_of_Cats_Collection_FOR_GIFTS/

notes.title: A Shelter Full of Cats is here!
notes.notes:
Hello hoomans! 

The wait is over—[b]A Shelter Full of Cats[/b] is officially here!  Join us in a peaceful countryside shelter, where you’ll meet a variety of adorable, special-needs cats who have so much love to give. ːfofino2ː

Help Hannah, a compassionate caretaker with her own story to tell, manage the shelter and care for these unique kitties. With a beautiful new art style, a soothing rural ambiance, and an original soundtrack that sets the perfect mood, we created this game to be a relaxing and meaningful escape for all cat lovers! ːfofinoː

And remember, [b]A Building Full of Cats 2[/b] is on the horizon! This sequel to our first "Full of Cats" game is bringing even more feline fun.  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810730/A_Building_Full_of_Cats_2

Make sure to wishlist it now so you'll keep up with our updates!

Thank you for your continued love and support—A Shelter Full of Cats is live now, and we can’t wait for you to experience it! ːcathspawː

Love and purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: Cute Cats with Special Needs
notes.notes:
Hello hoomans!

In [b]A Shelter Full of Cats[/b], we’re shining a spotlight on cats with special needs, who are just as full of life, love, and playfulness as any other kitty. ːfofino2ː

These incredible cats often face challenges in finding forever homes, yet they have so much joy and companionship to give. In our game, you’ll get to know these special cats up close and get a glimpse of their unique personalities. We hope this experience will inspire more love and awareness for all cats, reminding us that every kitty deserves a chance at happiness! ːemotionalcatː

[b]A Shelter Full of Cats[/b] releases on December 9th! Thank you for all your love and support!

Love and purrs,
The Devcats

notes.title: The Art of A Shelter Full of Cats
notes.notes:
Hello hoomans!

We’ve got something a little different in [b]A Shelter Full of Cats[/b]—a new art style that adds a unique touch to our latest game! ːcathspawː

This time, we wanted the setting and characters, including Hannah, our very first human character, to blend seamlessly with the peaceful countryside feel. 
The result? A style that’s just a bit more realistic and perfectly fitting for the shelter’s warm, welcoming spirit. We’re so excited for you to see this new look, and we hope you enjoy this fresh take! ːwinkycatː

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ihYywex.png[/img]

Save the date! [b]A Shelter Full of Cats[/b] releases on December 9th, and we can’t wait to share it with you. 
Thank you for your enduring love and support! ːfofino2ː

Love and purrs,
The Devcats

notes.title: Demo is coming on October 7th
notes.notes:
Hello hoomans! ːcathspawː

Great mews! ːlovecatː The demo for [b]A Shelter Full of Cats[/b] will be launching on October 7th! This is just a small taste to get you warmed up for the full game, coming at the end of the year.

In the demo, you’ll get to explore a part of the shelter located in a peaceful rural area and meet Hannah, the kind-hearted soul who takes care of all the special residents. ːfofino2ː

[b]A Shelter Full of Cats[/b] is an exciting new project for us, where we’ll be exploring some things we haven’t done before especially concerning narrative. It will be a wholesome and cozy experience, and, while it won't have many fantasy elements or be as expansive as [b]A Tower Full of Cats[/b], you can still expect a few surprises. ːwinkycatː

We can't wait for you to step into this new adventure with us! Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for your continued support! ːemotionalcatː

Love and purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ
